results.reply: A transformer is a neural network architecture that processes entire sequences of data at once (in parallel) rather than one step at a time, using a mechanism called **attention** to weigh how relevant each word is to every other word. This parallel design makes it far faster to train than older recurrent networks, which is why it powers modern language models like GPT and me. Its core innovation is self-attention, which lets the model capture long-range relationships and context in text.
